entries.title: Lamentations 5:1
segments: ¶Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.

words.text: , what is come upon us: consider

entries.title: Lamentations 5:2
segments: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:3
segments: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers [are] as widows.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:4
segments: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us. {is...: Heb. cometh for price}

words.text: unto us. {is...: Heb. cometh for price}

entries.title: Lamentations 5:5
segments: Our necks [are] under persecution: we labour, [and] have no rest. {Our...: Heb. On our necks are we persecuted}

words.text: . {Our...: Heb. On our necks are we persecuted}

entries.title: Lamentations 5:6
segments: We have given the hand [to] the Egyptians, [and to] the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:7
segments: Our fathers have sinned, [and are] not; and we have borne their iniquities.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:8
segments: Servants have ruled over us: [there is] none that doth deliver [us] out of their hand.

words.text: over us: [there is] none that doth deliver

entries.title: Lamentations 5:9
segments: We gat our bread with [the peril of] our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:10
segments: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine. {terrible: or, terrors, or, storms}

entries.title: Lamentations 5:11
segments: They ravished the women in Zion, [and] the maids in the cities of Judah.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:12
segments: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:13
segments: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:14
segments: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:15
segments: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:16
segments: The crown is fallen [from] our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned! {The...: Heb. The crown of our head is fallen}

words.text: unto us, that we have sinned
! {The...: Heb. The crown of our head is fallen}

entries.title: Lamentations 5:17
segments: ¶For this our heart is faint; for these [things] our eyes are dim.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:18
segments: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:19
segments: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:20
segments: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, [and] forsake us so long time? {so...: Heb. for length of days?}

entries.title: Lamentations 5:21
segments: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.

words.text: thou us unto thee, O LORD

entries.title: Lamentations 5:22
segments: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us. {But...: or, For wilt thou utterly reject us?}

words.text: against us. {But...: or, For wilt thou utterly reject us?}
